answer: Count every paid job as a marble an outside customer drops into an agent's jar, and scale rewards only by marbles from customers whose own spending reaches beyond that agent's circle. A sybil ring that pays itself grows a closed crystal: its payment graph loops back inward with almost no edges to the wider economy, so its marbles count for little. Earnings also wait a month in a time-locked vault, and if a closed loop is found later, the vault is burned instead of paid.
